title: What If Every Sea Star Vanished?

scenes.text: What if every sea star vanished? One famous experiment tried it on a single shore.
Ecologist Robert Paine pulled one species, the ochre sea star, off a rocky Pacific shore.
That shore held fifteen species clinging to the rocks. He removed only the sea star.
Mussels, its favorite meal, spread fast and crowded out the rest.
After three years, only eight species were left.
After ten years, the shore was mostly one species: mussels. One predator had held the whole place together.

description:
What if every sea star vanished?
When scientists removed one sea star species from a shore, fifteen species dropped to eight in three years.
What should we run through next?
first_comment: Which animal would you guess holds its whole habitat together? Drop your own 'what if' too.
